description:
Create a thematic choropleth map showing world population.

1. Open QGIS (if not already open).
2. Load the vector layer '/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson'.
3. Apply a 'Graduated' symbology to the layer based on the 'POP_EST' (population estimate) field.
4. Use a suitable color ramp (e.g., Reds or Spectral) and classify the data into at least 5 classes.
5. Save the project as 'world_population_map.qgz' in '/home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/'.
6. Export the map canvas as a PNG image to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/world_population_map.png'. Ensure the image is at least 800x600 pixels.
